name: Wayta, Trainer Prodigy
oracle_text:
Haste
{2}{G}, {T}: Target creature you control fights another target creature. This ability costs {2} less to activate if it targets two creatures you control.
If a creature you control being dealt damage causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
blocked_sentences: {2}{G}, {T}: Target creature you control fights another target creature. This ability costs {2} less to activate if it targets two creatures you control.
If a creature you control being dealt damage causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

needs.what: an activated ability's mana_reduction gated on its chosen targets where EVERY object target (here both fight targets) must match the filter (Creature, controller you), not just any one of them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `targeting` gate (cost_reduction.own_reduction / ability_cost_reduction) is true when ANY object target matches; since the first fight target is always a creature you control, any-match would discount every activation. It is also documented for a card's own spell cost_reduction, not for an activated ability's cost.mana_reduction

needs.what: a double_triggers cause clause meaning 'a creature you control being dealt damage': only the permanent half of DAMAGE_DEALT (to='permanent') whose victim (oid) is a creature you control counts as the cause
needs.why_existing_wont_do: double_triggers with cause_events ['dealt_damage'] + cause_filter {types: Creature, controller: you} loads, but triggers._cause_matches never applies EVENT_HALVES, and on the player half of DAMAGE_DEALT (no oid) _subject_oid falls through to event.source, the dealer -- so your creature dealing damage to a player would also double triggers, which is wider than the printed line. Needs _cause_matches to honour _half_matches (or a dedicated flag like cause_combat_damage_to_player)
